archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (AI & Sports Glassmorphism Variant)

headings.usage_rules: Tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for H1/H2. Left-align or intentional asymmetry. NEVER use Inter.

surfaces.glassmorphism_heavy: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] backdrop-saturate-150
surfaces.tracing_beam_card: relative overflow-hidden bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-gray-200 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 rounded-2xl

layout_and_spacing.grid_bento_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12
layout_and_spacing.grid_bento_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

sections.name: Floating Glassmorphism Navbar
sections.structure: Fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[90%] max-w-5xl z-50 rounded-full py-3 px-6

sections.name: Cinematic Hero Section
sections.structure: min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center relative overflow-hidden text-center md:text-left pt-32
sections.motion: GSAP stagger text reveal. Spotlight reveal on mousemove.
sections.visuals: Abstract silver/white background. Soft blue glowing blurred spheres in the background. Massive Outfit typography.

sections.name: Sports Showcase
sections.structure: Sticky horizontal scrolling section (200vh track). framer-motion useScroll or GSAP ScrollTrigger.
sections.visuals: Large cards (glassmorphism_light) containing vivid sports imagery with glowing AI overlay UI (bounding boxes, ball trajectory lines).

sections.name: How It Works Timeline
sections.structure: Vertical centered line glowing with blue/green gradient. Alternating content blocks left/right.
sections.motion: Nodes light up as user scrolls down.

sections.name: Live AI Dashboard
sections.structure: Bento Grid Mode B (Control Room Grid). High density, functional.

sections.name: Video Storytelling
sections.structure: Full-width section with massive border-radius (rounded-[3rem]). Cinematic video thumbnail with heavy glassmorphism play button centered.
sections.visuals: Use video_thumbnail image with bg-black/20 overlay.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.structure: Grid of 3 cards. Center card scaled up 1.05x with 'tracing_beam_card' styling and subtle stadium_green glow.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.structure: Customized Shadcn Accordion. Minimal borders, elegant open/close animations.

sections.name: Footer
sections.structure: py-32 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200 flex flex-col items-center. Massive 'EMPIRE AI' display text at the bottom.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_effects: Mandatory setup of Lenis (smooth scrolling). GSAP ScrollTrigger for revealing sections with y:40 -> y:0 and opacity:0 -> opacity:1.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Magnetic buttons for primary CTAs. Spotlight effect (radial gradient background following mouse) on key pricing/feature cards.

media_urls.description: Abstract white and light silver background for a clean Apple-like aesthetic

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast standards required. Use #0A0A0A for text on white/gray.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap GSAP/Framer animations in prefers-reduced-motion checks.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='navbar-book-demo').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize layout with Pure HTML/Tailwind for structural marketing sections (Hero, Showcase).
2. Install and configure @studio-freight/react-lenis for premium smooth scrolling.
3. Use framer-motion or gsap for scroll animations, text reveals, and the horizontal scrolling in the Showcase section.
4. Import Outfit font for headings and Manrope for body text via Google Fonts.
5. Use Shadcn UI for complex interactive forms (Email Collection, Contact, Accordion), overriding default Vercel styles with custom glassmorphism and rounded-2xl utilities.
6. Do NOT use placeholder text or dummy image URLs. ALWAYS use the real Unsplash media_urls provided.
7. Ensure the UI feels bright, immersive, and premium ('Apple Keynote meets live sports').
